item.excerpt:encoded: The Air Jordan XXXVI isn't just the next up in the iconic franchise; it's an expression of the drive and energy that sparked a basketball revolution. It's one of the lightest Air Jordan game shoes to date, featuring a minimal but durable Leno-Weave upper reinforced with a TPU ribbon. Step on the court with the confidence that whatever you do—it's light work.

item.excerpt:encoded: The Nike SuperRep Go 2 with speckle accents combines lightweight cushioning underfoot and breathable mesh up top to get you moving comfortably in circuit-based fitness classes or while streaming workouts at home. With the supportive arc on the side and extra flexibility in the sole, you're ready to go for 1 more rep.
